newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian RAMS sets final Series A NIM bonds.
newsitem.headline: Australian RAMS sets final Series A NIM bonds.

text.p: RAMS Home Loans is making its final A$5 million issue of its Net Interest Margin (NIM) Series A Bonds, Australian Securitised Funding (ASF) said on Monday.

This third tranche will be fully fungible with RAMS previous two NIM issues bringing the Series A total to A$29.6 million, and will be sold to current holders at par. Settlement will be on June 25, said ASF, the non-bank lender's funding arranger.
The bonds will be serviced from the net interest margin arising from about A$1,300 million in RAMS mortgages.

"The issuing of NIM bonds allows RAMS to address the difference in timing of its costs and the income it generates from the home mortgages pool, funded by RAMS Mortgage Corporation Limited," said ASF Director Robin Redfern.
The lead placement agent is JP Morgan with Bankers Trust as Co-placement agent.
